lead: Thilakan was an Indian actor, born on 15 July 1935 in Ayiroor.
He died on 24 September 2012 in Thiruvananthapuram at the age of 77.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards South and National Film Award for Best Supporting Actor.
Below you will find a verified overview of Thilakan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
